title: feat(cloud-connection): one-click bind UX — zero-input panel + device-context approval page
body:
## Summary

UI half of [cloud ADR runtime-identity-binding](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/blob/main/docs/design/runtime-identity-binding.md) §2.3 — pairs with [framework#1783](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/framework/pull/1783) + [framework#1784](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/framework/pull/1784) + [cloud#264](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/pull/264). The binding flow becomes GitHub-grade: one click, no UUIDs.

**CloudConnectionPanel** (`cloud-connection:panel`):
- Environment-id input **removed** — the registration row is created cloud-side at approval; nothing is pasted into this page anymore
- Connect **auto-opens the approval page in a popup** (still inside the click's transient activation); the big user-code display demotes to the popup-blocked fallback
- Bound view shows the registered **runtime name + runtime id** (device-model identity)

**DeviceAuthPage** (`/auth/device`):
- Shows the requesting device's context — `runtime_name` / `runtime_version` appended to the verification URL by the runtime's bind/start
- Adds the **"only approve if you started this connection yourself"** warning — the informed-consent line for RFC 8628's known phishing surface

**i18n**: 2 new `auth.device.*` keys added to all 10 locales.

## Tests
- app-shell 435/435, i18n 100/100, app-shell type-check clean, console app builds clean
